responsibility: Defines the SPU backend’s machine-specific RTL operand constraints used by instruction recognition and reload for the Cell SPU port. It classifies immediates by the exact instruction forms that can materialize or consume them (such as il/ila/ilh/ilhu, arithmetic, logical, iohl, fsmbi, c*d pattern constants, shift counts, and floating exp2 forms) and also defines call-related memory constraints for indirect, relative, and absolute call operands, giving the .md patterns in spu.md precise legality tests tied to helper predicates in spu.c.
